text:
emma (docs): opened PR 427: console/cost-attribution.md — swaps dashboard preset and adds new per-route cost matrix example. pls PTAL to tracehook examples for Node + Go. linkchecks too.
jon (eng-runtime): looking now. question: did you change tracekey -> trace_id? we standardized on trace_id in new hook.
emma (docs): yes switched to trace_id, but left old param in a note. maybe remove note per API compatibility?
sam (eng-platform): I think keep note for two releases, but add migration code. I can add a tiny compatibility shim in sdk snippet.
priya (devex): SDK snippet failing our linter on line with async iterator. I'll push a quick fix in a branch.
lisa (product): Any UX changes to preset pinning? Customer asked about pinning a dashboard to a model variant.
emma (docs): added a short callout: "dashboard preset pinning (beta)". not linking to product page yet. want a screenshot — @sam can you grab a high-level mock? :camera: 
sam (eng-platform): grabbing screenshot, will upload to PR in ~30m. note: screenshot needs blurred keys.
link-bot: auto-link-check: 3 broken links found in PR -> console/images/* , docs/old-tracehook.md, sample-sdks/node/old-path. See PR comments.
emma (docs): thanks link-bot. I'm fixing paths. also will add migration note with command snippet:
```bash
grep -R "tracekey" -n docs | xargs sed -i "s/tracekey/trace_id/g"
```
jon (eng-runtime): small nit: in node snippet you use kvPrefetch: true — that's runtime-only flag, should be in server config not per-request. changed in review.
priya (devex): updated node snippet to use client config. also added a short explanation about latency/throughput tradeoffs for kv prefetch.
sam (eng-platform): added compatibility shim snippet to PR: sample-sdks/node/compat-traceid.js
emma (docs): ok merging after one more :eyes: from eng-runtime and a green link-check. leaving a TODO for backfill of examples in Go. cc @lisa
lisa (product): great, please include a short sentence about SLA behavior when fallbacks happen.
emma (docs): done. merging in 10m unless more blockers. :shipit: 
deploy-bot: docs-ci / link-checker passed. docs-ci / e2e-samples failed on go-sample (timeout) — rerunning.
sam (eng-platform): reran e2e for go sample, it passed. go's timeout was fixed by bumping test timeouts in CI.
emma (docs): merged. will schedule a small cleanup PR to remove the note after 2 releases. thanks everyone! :tada:
